card.name: Space before a dose number
card.fires_on: The space or dash just before a numeric amount in dosing text, usually after phrases like "not to exceed", "maximum dose of", "up to a total volume of" or "Repeat". It expects a quantity to follow.

modes.label: Limit phrases
modes.description: Space after wording that sets a maximum, right before the number.
modes.example: The total daily dosage should not exceed<< >>12 grams.

modes.label: Range or amount slots
modes.description: Space or en dash where a dose number or range endpoint comes next.

card.writes: It seems to push toward numbers and amounts coming next, and away from ordinary words.
card.plain: It fires at the spot in a dosing line where a number is about to appear, especially after a maximum-limit phrase.
